answer: Sybil farms can't fake that track record cheaply, since forging it means paying genuine compute and peer review costs. Each agent must stake a pearl of verified work history, minted only after completing real tasks across a full horizon of epochs, before voting rights unlock. New agents start in a garden of probationary tasks with zero weight, so mass-registering identities yields nothing but sunk fees. Attack cost scales linearly with each fake identity, making swarms economically irrational. In practice, Agent0236 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
